item.nusmp.star_king_dragon_core.desc: The eye of the Star King Dragon, cut from its heart. A crafting core: it can be socketed into a Grimoire to turn its magic into raw Stardust.
item.nusmp.star_king_dragon_core.card: Dropped by Veldanava (1 per fighter). Combat compatibility: socketed into a Grimoire it would convert all elemental magic into raw, unblockable Stardust magic, and it is the main ingredient of the Aura of the Creator (those two uses are crafted by other systems; this item is the material).
item.nusmp.genesis_fragment.desc: A shard of the moment of creation. Used at an anvil or forge to push a weapon past the enchanting limits.
item.nusmp.genesis_fragment.card: Dropped by Veldanava (3 per fighter). Combat compatibility: used in an anvil or a forge to upgrade weapons beyond the usual enchantment limits, granting Unbreakable and a faster base attack speed (the upgrade recipe is crafted by other systems; this item is the material).
item.nusmp.creators_essence.desc: Use it to refill your health, food and magicules and to clear every cooldown. The panic button of a raid.
item.nusmp.creators_essence.card: Dropped by Veldanava (1 per fighter). Right-click: full health and food, every bad effect removed, Regeneration and Absorption for a while, the magicules full and every item and hero-weapon cooldown cleared. It is used up.
item.nusmp.justice_king_michael_fragment: Consume it to be guarded by an absolute barrier that turns away one fatal blow a day.

Rare drop of Veldanava. Right-click to consume it once: from then on, the first blow each day that would kill you is turned away (the barrier is checked before totems and other saves). Kept in your player data, through death.
Held in the hand it lets you step through space: a dash of up to fourteen blocks with no fall damage.

Rare drop of Veldanava. Right-click to step up to 14 blocks along your look direction to the furthest spot your body fits, with no fall damage (2 second cooldown). It is not used up: a vastly better Ender Pearl that never breaks.
item.nusmp.nihility_fragment.desc: Held in the off hand it coats your blows in void: what you strike cannot heal for five seconds.
item.nusmp.nihility_fragment.card: Rare drop of Veldanava. Keep it in the off hand. Anything you strike with a weapon in the main hand cannot regain health for 5 seconds (the healing-debuff the guide calls Anti-Magic), which answers bosses that regenerate. It is not used up.
item.nusmp.veldanavas_divine_core.desc: A limitless source of power. In the off hand it negates the cost of ultimate spells.
item.nusmp.veldanavas_divine_core.card: Ultra-rare drop of Veldanava (about 1 in 100 per fighter). Combat compatibility: held in the off hand it is meant to negate the mana or stamina cost of any ultimate spell of any anime system in the mod (the hook is in the Ultimate Magic system's cost step; the item itself is the key).
